Check out our 'Ultimate English Language & Literature AQA GCSE Course': https://www.firstratetutors.com/gcse-course

Free GCSE English revision guides: https://www.firstratetutors.com/gcsefreematerial

Struggling with comparing two texts in your GCSE exams? Maybe you have to compare two different poems or two different types of texts - but you don't know where to begin or how to even plan this type of essay? Not to worry - we've got you covered! Barbara, a qualified English teacher, walks you through a framework which will help you secure Level 9 marks in your essay if you practice and apply this framework in your essay writing!
